title: Predictive Stability and Adaptation Under Distribution Shift: Calibration, Discrimination, and Decision Thresholds in Credit-Risk Modeling
description: Publication manuscript and research materials for a credit-risk study of calibration, discrimination, and decision thresholds under distribution shift. Includes the supplied 17-page manuscript, R Markdown source, bibliography, adaptation summary data, revision checks, and supporting empirical and reconstructed initial simulation code. See VERIFICATION_STATUS.md for reproducibility limitations. Poster and individual loan records are excluded.
